description: This Lua script creates a simple graphical application that opens a window, renders a bouncing circle, and displays the current frame rate. It demonstrates basic graphics rendering and animation in Lua, likely within a framework like Codea.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the window and sets the desired frame rate for the animation.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Main rendering loop that updates the background, displays frame rate, draws a circle, and handles bounce logic.
